rows.note: A city may adopt a tax at half the county rate (R&TC 11911(b)); city-level amounts for either property are not verified (see FL-13).

rows.note: Notice goes to beneficiaries and heirs of the deceased settlor, with the content listed in subdivision (g).

rows.item: Statewide residential rent cap (AB 1482, Civil Code 1947.12)
rows.value: 5% plus local CPI change, maximum 10% per 12 months
rows.note: Exempt: rent-controlled units (local ordinance), housing with a certificate of occupancy within 15 years, and qualifying single-family or condo units alienable separately.

categories.title: California property tax: Prop 13 and Prop 19 (parent-child transfers)

rows.item: 2026-27 assessment inflation factor (Prop 13)
rows.note: Applies to the factored base-year value (assessed value grows at up to 2% per year absent a change in ownership).

rows.item: Prop 19 value limit for parent-child family-home transfers
rows.note: Adjusted for inflation every two years; the next adjustment is in February 2027.

rows.item: Exclusion applies only if the transferee makes the property a principal residence
rows.note: Rentals and non-occupied property are fully reassessed at full cash value on transfer (BOE LTA 2026/026).

rows.item: Deadline to file BOE-19-P (claim)
rows.value: Within 3 years of transfer, or before any third-party transfer, whichever is earlier
rows.note: Late filing may get prospective relief (see BOE LTA 2026/026).

rows.item: Deadline to file BOE-266 (homeowners' exemption for the new residence)
rows.value: Within 1 year of the change in principal residence

rows.item: Multi-unit properties
rows.value: Only the unit occupied as principal residence qualifies; other units reassessed at full cash value
rows.note: BOE LTA 2026/026 (Q5, Q15). How value is allocated between units is decided by the assessor.

rows.item: Exclusion removed when the child no longer occupies the home
rows.value: Yes (on next lien date after moving out)

rows.item: Trust ownership
rows.value: Trust is looked through; eligible if Section 63.2 is met

rows.item: Transfer to an LLC
Homeowners' exemption (reduction in taxable value)
rows.note: File BOE-266 by February 15. Notify the assessor by December 10 if no longer eligible.

SB 974 (effective 1/1/2027): special-needs-trust transfers eligible for the Prop 19 exclusion
